notes.title: Achievements and other gizmos! 🎉🎊
notes.content:
[code] The update is already available for download. You may need to restart Steam. Enjoy the game! [/code]

The first update is available. This time we have added:

[list]
[*] Added 10 achievements.
[*] The last used device is now shown in the control prompts. If you have connected a gamepad, there will be prompts with gamepad buttons, and vice versa. Works for devices: Keyboard, PlayStation gamepads, Xbox gamepads.
[*] Disabled mouse control in main menu and pause menu.
[*] Chapter covers.
[*] Fixes in main menu.
[/list]
